# `vox-build-queue`

**Crate:** `vox-build-queue` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Fair FIFO build queue, cargo resolution, and build metrics for the vox build broker

## Crate Overview

Pure logic for the vox build broker: cargo resolution, fair queueing, metrics.

See `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-unified-build-broker-design.md`.
